White metro tiles, duck-egg walls, black-and-white hexagon floor; LANDMARKS glass walk-in shower (left), white claw-foot bathtub (right), pedestal washbasin under an oval mirror (zoom z1). Back wall: white door half open onto the bedroom (-> R_bedroom_01). Feminine left of x=805: poodle grooming at the dressing table (toilette), sheepdog under the shower (douche), butler with a towel swan (serviette), dressed boy washing his hands in a bowl (hygiene), bulldog Ben in a tin tub with rubber ducks (baignoire; no child bathing). Masculine right: bear with a banjo in the claw-foot bath (bain), robin on the shelf by the tap (robinet), little calf with a lace handkerchief in front of the tub (mouchoir), duckling on a bar of soap (savon), tabby on the stool (tabouret).
